meaning: Which .svb is the current recommended file for each clip. Machine-readable on purpose:
before 2026-09-05 the answer lived only in prose inside the issue log, and a build was
derived from a superseded file four times (D-002, D-006 animal, the human preremovalfix,
and bundle_shots_depthscale_test) -- each time silently dropping a fix that was already in.
Any new bundle must be derived from the file named in `recommended` for its clip.
scripts/replace_bundle_sidecar.py enforces this and refuses a superseded base.
After delivering a new recommended build, update this file in the same commit.
2026-09-09: manifest.anchor_z_policy now records which quantity anchor_z holds per category; rawAnchor.source in the sidecar stays authoritative per frame.

2026-09-10: buildParams records the flags a rebuild of each clip must use. run_sam2_to_bundle.py reads this and applies them for registry directories, because the orchestrator's own defaults do not match them (--bundle-quant-pos-scale defaults to None, i.e. the builder's 0.0002, which would silently revert D-008 on train).

notes.paths: `dir` is the job directory basename under shared_volume/sam2_bundle_jobs/ on the generating side. The consuming side keeps its own layout; match on `file` + `sha256`.
notes.sha256: Of the whole .svb. Both sides can verify they hold the same file without trusting a name.
